comparison_summary.conclusion: Multimodal fusion outperforms single-modality baselines by leveraging cross-modal consistency indicators and complementary feature spaces.

experiment_2.title: Fusion Strategy Comparison (Feature vs Cross-Attention vs Decision)

feature_level.strengths: Fast computation, straightforward tensor concatenation with bilinear interaction.
feature_level.limitations: Does not model asymmetric directed attention between modalities.

cross_attention.strengths: Bidirectional attention maps allow textual queries to directly probe visual & acoustic evidence.
cross_attention.limitations: Slightly higher parameter count and computational footprint.

decision_level.strengths: Highly modular; can incorporate off-the-shelf black-box modality classifiers without retraining.
decision_level.limitations: Lacks early and mid-level feature cross-pollination.

experiment_6.interpretation: High drop in model confidence upon masking top attributed tokens confirms that explanations are faithful to the model's internal representations rather than post-hoc hallucinations.
